photos.name: img-7718
photos.summary: Cooled loaf on a copper wire rack from a low side angle, dark mahogany crust with charred patches and visible burned currants on top.

photos.name: img-7719
photos.summary: Hero-ish three-quarter view of the whole loaf on the copper rack with kitchen and clock blurred in the background, golden flour-dusted crust with dark currant flecks and a clean ear.

photos.name: img-7720
photos.summary: Top-down shot of the loaf on the copper rack held over a tile floor, full scoring pattern visible with scorched currants along the high edges.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-001
photos.summary: Motion-blurred shot of the loaf being set down onto a white cutting board, purple knife sheath in the foreground.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-002
photos.summary: Loaf held up bottom-first toward the camera, showing the pale floured base with scattered currant specks.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-003
photos.summary: Bottom of the loaf again from a slightly lower angle, floured base with dark currant studs across the surface.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-004
photos.summary: Underside of the loaf tilting forward, darker bake color and burned currants beginning to show along the rim.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-005
photos.summary: Hand reaching across the loaf base mid-rotation, base still upturned to camera.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-006
photos.summary: Loaf tipping over from upside-down toward upright, partial side view with one hand supporting it.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-007
photos.summary: Loaf set right-side-up on the cutting board with both hands gripping the sides, dark scored top now visible.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-008
photos.summary: Top-down view of the upright loaf on the cutting board, blurred purple bread knife entering the frame from the left.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-009
photos.summary: Purple bread knife resting across the top of the loaf, scoring pattern and currant specks clearly visible.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-010
photos.summary: Knife held above the loaf at a slight diagonal, lined up to start the cut down the center.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-011
photos.summary: Knife angled down onto the crust, free hand steadying the top of the loaf.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-012
photos.summary: Knife tip pressing into the crust at the start of the cut, hand bracing the far side.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-013
photos.summary: Knife sawing into the top of the loaf, hand stabilizing across the back.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-014
photos.summary: Knife further into the cut, blade partially buried in the crust near the ear.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-015
photos.summary: Mid-cut from the front, knife working through the upper half of the loaf with the ear curling above the blade.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-016
photos.summary: Knife deeper into the cut, free hand pressed across the top to hold the loaf steady.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-017
photos.summary: Knife angled steeply downward into the loaf, sawing through the lower portion.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-018
photos.summary: Knife near the bottom of the loaf, hand still gripping the top with the ear standing tall above the cut.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-019
photos.summary: Knife withdrawing slightly from the cut, loaf still intact on the cutting board.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-020
photos.summary: Knife re-entering the cut for another pass, ear and scoring pattern visible from above.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-021
photos.summary: Knife pulled back from the cut, hand still resting on the loaf top mid-sequence.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-022
photos.summary: Hand resting on the cut loaf with knife withdrawn, top-down view of scored crust before pulling halves apart.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-023
photos.summary: Whole loaf settled back on the cutting board with cut line visible down the middle, knife resting to the side.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-024
photos.summary: Motion-blurred shot of the loaf being lifted off the board, cut side starting to separate.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-025
photos.summary: Both halves held cut-side toward the camera, revealing the open crumb with dense walnut and currant studding.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-026
photos.summary: Closer crumb shot of both halves angled toward the camera, pale interior with heavy walnut/currant inclusions and a faint purple tint near the nuts.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-027
photos.summary: Tight, slightly skewed top-down view of both cut halves stacked, showing crumb structure with thick dark walnut and currant inclusions throughout.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-028
photos.summary: Extreme close-up crumb shot with both halves stacked, dense walnut chunks and currants packed through a relatively tight interior.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-029
photos.summary: Motion-blurred frame of the halves being swung back together or rotated, hard to read.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-030
photos.summary: Heavily blurred mid-motion frame of the loaf being lifted or repositioned, scissors visible in the background.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-031
photos.summary: One half held tilted toward the camera showing the floured outer crust and burned currant patches near the rim.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-032
photos.summary: Half loaf held base-up toward the camera, pale floured underside with scattered dark currants and good even bake color.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-033
photos.summary: Both halves cradled in hands above the cutting board with cut sides angled toward each other, walnut-studded crumb visible at the seam.

photos.name: img-7721-frame-034
photos.summary: Final composed shot on the cutting board: cut half standing on edge revealing crumb beside the closed half showing crust, knife resting to the left.
